column1: # Load-bearing citations into the reference corpus, and what each line must say.
#   `scripts/check-citations.py` proves a cited line EXISTS. It cannot prove the
#   line says what the citation claims. On 2026-08-31 four documents cited
#   `ngosang_trackerslist.pas:93` for a `.Clear` call that is on line 98; line 93
#   is a comment. The citation checker passed it, because 93 is a real line.
#   So every citation this project's ARGUMENT rests on gets a row here naming a
#   substring the line must contain. A corpus refresh that moves a line now
#   fails a gate instead of silently orphaning a claim.
# FORMAT   path <TAB> line <TAB> substring the line must contain
#   Paths are relative to the repository root. Blank lines and `#` are ignored.
#   The substring is matched literally, after both sides are stripped.
#   Add one whenever a document starts resting on a specific line of somebody
#   else's code. If the line later moves, this fails, and the fix is to re-read
#   the file and correct BOTH the citation and this row -- never only this row.
# --- newTrackon: the oracle, the opt-out, the cadence, the identity ---
